clip_grad_norm_: clip the gradient norms of model parameters to a specified max norm value
make_positions: replace non-padding tokens in a tensor with their sequential position numbers
post_process_prediction: post-process model predictions by removing BPE symbols and replacing unknown tokens
get_activation_fn: get a callable activation function by name such as relu, gelu, or silu
resolve_max_positions: resolve the minimum max position constraints from multiple model sources
